title: Colour and d–d transitions
basic_overview: Colour can arise from d–d or charge-transfer transitions. d⁰/d¹⁰ ions lack ordinary d–d transitions.

extra_info_content.short_trick: Absorbed colour and observed colour are complementary.
extra_info_content.step_by_step: 1. d count. 2. Check split d levels. 3. Photon hν=Δ. 4. Excite electron. 5. Complementary colour is observed.
extra_info_content.factors: Selection rules affect intensity; CT bands can be much stronger.
extra_info_content.kinetics_or_energy: Compare thermodynamic driving force with kinetic barrier when relevant; do not treat a favourable ΔG° as proof of a fast reaction.
